title: Quick-Fix-Fermented Dutch Cherries Wrap
description: A Jain-friendly, fermented, fluffy Dutch dish featuring cherries, wrapped in a leaf and steamed for a quick fix.

ingredients.name: 2 large leaves (from banana or plantain plant)
ingredients.notes: large enough to wrap the filling

instructions: Rinse the cherries and pat them dry with a clean cloth.
In a large bowl, mix the cherries with coconut sugar, yeast, and cinnamon.
Add the melted coconut oil, lemon zest, and lemon juice. Mix well.
Let the mixture sit at room temperature for 30 minutes, allowing the yeast to ferment.
Preheat a steamer basket with large leaves in a pot of boiling water.
Using a spoon, scoop the fermented cherry mixture onto the center of a leaf.
Fold the leaf over the filling to form a neat package.
Place the package in the steamer basket and steam for 5-7 minutes.
Serve the fermented cherry wrap hot, garnished with a sprinkle of salt.
